purpose: Workshop learning gate for a tiny synthetic sample; not production assurance.
release_requirements: All critical assertions in development and holdout pass.
At least 7 of 8 development cases pass as complete cases.
At least 3 of 4 holdout cases pass as complete cases.
Relevant observed latency and cost budgets pass only when genuinely measured.
insufficient_evidence_conditions: A run, trace, metric, configuration fingerprint, or critical case result is missing.
A result belongs to a different candidate fingerprint.
A call is incomplete, timed out, access blocked, or infrastructure blocked.
Pricing or measured consumption is missing when making a cost claim.

authorization_gate.proof: T02 and T03 under prepared principals, or explicitly unproven
